mission: Compare public/authorized Chinese technology, products, manufacturing capability and supplier ecosystems with current U.S. availability/capability, then surface evidence-backed sourcing, domestic-manufacturing, Shopify, Amazon, wholesale and contract opportunities.
source_classes: U.S. manufacturer directories and permitted supplier APIs/feeds
public research papers and technical documentation

us_gap_confidence.high: multiple independent U.S. searches show no close domestic equivalent and source coverage is strong
us_gap_confidence.medium: few/weak equivalents found; more validation required
us_gap_confidence.low: coverage incomplete or domestic equivalents may exist

guardrails: respect marketplace/API terms and rate limits
do not claim manufacturer identity without verification
do not claim U.S. absence from one failed search
screen legal/regulatory/IP/trade risks before recommending sale/import
label estimated margins and demand as estimates
truth_rule: The scout identifies opportunities from bounded current evidence. It does not prove a technology is unavailable in the U.S., a supplier is genuine, a product may legally be imported/sold, or an ecommerce opportunity will be profitable without further validation.
